title: Business Platinum Rewards Card: Which Media and Advertising Expenses Qualify?
summary: This document explains which media and advertising expenses qualify for the Business Platinum Rewards Card, including qualifying digital ads (4.0% earn rate) such as search engine marketing, social media ads, programmatic display, retargeting, and streaming audio/video billed by media networks or ad platforms. It also lists non-qualifying items—e.g., agency retainers, consulting/production costs coded as professional services, public relations, talent fees, event sponsorships coded outside advertising/media categories, and charges routed through non-media intermediaries using general business services merchant codes—and provides tips on direct billing, merchant classification checks, and keeping documentation.
faqs: Which types of digital advertising purchases qualify for 4.0% earning on the Business Platinum Rewards Card?
Do streaming audio/video media placements qualify, and what billing method is required?
Do creative agency retainers, production, or consulting fees qualify if they are part of an advertising campaign?
Will public relations services, talent fees, or event sponsorships earn rewards under this card?
What happens if an ad invoice is routed through an agency/intermediary—does it qualify?
How can I make sure my merchant category coding will be treated as an eligible advertising/media purchase?
keywords: Digital advertising on major online platforms
Streaming audio and video media placements
Non-qualifying merchant categories (professional services / general business services)
Direct billing from advertising or media platform
